title: Practice 3: Нет, не было: having none

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: There is no returning on the road of life.
exercises.why: Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word **нет** followed by the genitive case. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book.
